content: {"episode_id":"ep-05103","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the PR-204 denial of CPT 93271 (cardiac event monitoring) as not covered under the member's benefit plan. The clinical indication note documents a patient with a history of recurrent palpitations and episodes of syncope (R55), raising concern for underlying arrhythmia, with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) and supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1) identified as potential etiologies for these intermittent symptoms. The cardiac event monitor was ordered to capture rhythm data during symptomatic episodes to guide further management, as stated in the ordering documentation. We request reconsideration of the PR-204 determination for the outstanding balance of 398.38 based on this documented medical necessity."}
